scope: API authentication matrix: session cookie, OAuth login/callback, auth middleware, unauthenticated/expired/revoked sessions, login/logout/status consistency between UI and API.

contracts.v2Mount: v2Router.use(requireAuth) applies to every /api/v2 route before domain routers.
contracts.requireAuth: Missing userId/discordId => 401. Pending 2FA => 403. When sessionToken present, Prisma Session must be active, unexpired, and user-bound else 401 SESSION_REVOKED + cookie destroyed.
contracts.oauth: Discord-only OAuth with state/nonce/PKCE; session.save before redirects.
contracts.logout: Deactivates Prisma Session.isActive, clears tokenCache, destroys express-session.
contracts.status: /auth/status returns authenticated false when DB session inactive/expired (UI source of truth).
contracts.storeFailure: Session DB lookup failure => 503 SESSION_STORE_UNAVAILABLE fail-closed (no anonymous elevation).

cases.expected: Redirect Discord with state/PKCE stored in session
Validate state; create user/session; session.save before redirect

cases.scenario: Cookie still has userId but Prisma session revoked/expired
Frontend api client credentials include + Protected Navigate login
